comment: The maker's README names the two priority menu items 'Zone A priority (when monophonic)' and 'Zone B priority (when monophonic)'; the code creates them as 'Monophonic priority (Zone A)' and '(Zone B)' (src/Zones.cpp:602-611), which is what the menu prints. The split test is pitch greater than or equal to the threshold for Zone B, so the split note itself belongs to Zone B. The velocity and aftertouch ports are given no range because nothing in the module scales or clamps them; they are passed through as they arrive. The Aluminium theme submenu is on every module of this plugin and is left out of the lines.
